name: ad_failed_logon_collector
description: R158.50.7e (2026-10-07) supersedes 1.0.3. Two operator-requested fixes: (1) skip machine-account 4625 events (TargetUserName ending in '$') so /failed-logon-2h per-user pivot only sees real user attacks; (2) displayName lookup uses TargetDomainName instead of localhost, so cross-domain users get real displayName (bdm@KDL.LOCAL on KDLWGQWHADSRV1 used to show NULL). Skipped machine-account count is logged to stderr (R158.50.7c 'ok' placeholder pattern preserved). R158.50.7d [xml] param fix preserved (Get-EventDataField / Get-EventDataInt still use [Parameter()]).
